data.description:
## Context / Problem
On current `origin/main`, `.github/dependabot.yml` configures weekly `uv` and GitHub Actions updates. `CONTRIBUTING.md:671-678` still says updates are Actions-only, and `docs/releasing.md:588-593` says Actions updates run monthly. These user-facing instructions contradict the active configuration.

## Approach
Update both documents from `.github/dependabot.yml` as the source of truth, including cadence and the lock-backed uv ecosystem.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Both documents describe the configured ecosystems and weekly cadence accurately.
- [ ] The guidance names the lock-backed uv update behavior without duplicating configuration details likely to drift.
- [ ] Documentation checks and `make lint` pass.
data.title: Align Dependabot documentation with weekly uv and Actions updates
